purpose: Allow a compliant 5-field official racecard source to be paired with an independently admitted source for the 3 missing frozen features without synthesis.

duplicate_fields_if_supplement_also_expo.score: audit-only consistency signal; do not silently overwrite
duplicate_fields_if_supplement_also_expo.quinella_rate: audit-only consistency signal; do not silently overwrite
